method: tools/flipper_pull.py (storage list/storage read over the USB CLI)
note: Only the captures this repo did not already hold were copied. The rest of the device tree duplicates research/sources/corpus_automotive_subghz. Three frame-less multi-MB RAW recordings were triaged on the card and not retained: they carry no frame (see the research note for the analysis), so their hashes and structure are recorded here but the bytes are not shipped.
